All tests use the public endpoint (https://kainnusantara-stage.preview.emergentagent.com/api) to verify what users actually see.

conclusion: F1 feature (UOM/Units following master data) is correctly implemented and working as specified. Backend APIs return correct data with proper units (yard, kg, meter). Frontend code correctly uses product.base_unit throughout all modules (POS, WMS, Purchasing, Master Data). The dual unit display format (roll count + quantity-with-unit) is properly implemented. The 12 backend guardrail gates mentioned in the agent-to-agent context are confirmed GREEN with the new yard/kg products.
